Yes, if the claim is approved. The Plant Care Guarantee gives you **one** free replacement of the same plant, a bird of paradise. If it's out of stock, you'd get store credit instead.

- **Approval isn't confirmed yet.** A Plant Care Specialist still has to review your photos, and I can't see your claim's status or promise the outcome. Losing almost half its leaves is beyond the one-third threshold we count as significant decline, which works in your favour.
- **Your replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee.** If it fails too, it can be replaced once more, but that second replacement has no guarantee.
- **Shipping:** live plants ship **Monday to Wednesday only**. I don't have a set dispatch time for guarantee replacements, so I won't guess one. The Support Lead or specialist can confirm it once the claim is approved.

To get this moving, please send your order number (it looks like LF-123456) here so the Support Lead can chase the review. I haven't forgotten the one-time store credit of up to **$15** for the delayed reply, if you'd like it.
